lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5 to 6 vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the branchial region. The spots are arranged in a semi-regular grid with the highest intensity maxima concentrated in the mid-lateral area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a series of grid-like anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and low-luminance shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, dark-toned fusiform silhouettes (commensal organisms) attached to and swimming near the ventral and pectoral fin regions.
